text.p: These are the leading stories in Mozambique's Noticias newspaper on Friday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The governor of the northern Mozambican province of Nampula, Rosario Mualeia, has dismissed the wave of demonstrations organised by the former rebel movement Renamo as nothing more than a propaganda gambit.

- The Mozambican Minister of Industry, Trade and Tourism, Oldemiro Baloi, on Thursday called on Mozambican businesses to make greater efforts to improve the quality of their products, and thus become more competitive.
